title: Implementation of a 3D visualization environment for aircraft subsystem architectures and components during conceptual design
author: Pedro Henrique Ribeiro Bernini
abstract: The main objective of this project is to develop a 3D visualization environment, which can visualize the different results of the architecture design tools within a single program. Architecture-relevant data provided by the design tools must be converted into a unified 3D aircraft subsystem data description. Based on provided meta-information the visual-ization tool shall provide grouped overlays, different levels, interconnections, and infor-mation of 3D subsystem component models within the geometry of the aircraft. Thereby, low-fidelity as well as detailed architecture descriptions must be processable. For the program implementation, an existing 3D engine shall be leveraged using well-established graphics libraries. Moreover, the visualization tool shall be capable of depicting the air-crafts lofting and its subsystems by means of generic elements coming from a 3D aircraft component library. A visualization of a holistic aircraft subsystem architecture concept shall exemplify the beneficial analysis and validation capabilities of the implemented en-vironment.
